breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses PointSource to apply the concentrated vertical load at (0.5,0.5) on the y-displacement component, rather than distributing it as a uniform traction over the adjacent edges. This matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Represent each concentrated load with PointSource on the appropriate displacement component instead of smearing it over an edge.'
